Add to Cart Free Pickup from Grandville Ships from Grandville, West Michigan Warehouse All Dr. Scientist All Keyboards All Synthesizers Synth Modules The classic BitQuest guitar pedal now in modular synthesizer format! The BitQuest is a mono multi-effects module featuring 8 fun and adventurous patches that can be used with or without a built-in digital fuzz. The patches on hand include a full featured flanger, high pass and low pass filters, a bit crusher with sample rate reducer, an infinite reverb, a deep notch filter, a ring modulator with reverb, a +/- 1 octave pitch shifter, and a wild glitch delay. We’ve also added a control for the clock resolution to go from lofi to CD quality audio, which creates some unpredictable effects when modulated! Clock resolution and the three CTRL inputs can be controlled by CV. Wet, Dry and Mix outputs allow for parallel effect chains and routing. Comes with both a full color and a grayscale faceplate for aesthetic customization to match any rig. Ribbon cable for power is included. Features Multi-Effects Eurorack Module Flanger, High + Lowpass, Bit + Samplerate Reducer, Infinite Reverb. Deep Notch Filter, Ring Mod Reverb, +/- Octave Pitch Shifter, Glitch Delay Digital Fuzz Can be Added to Any Effect Three Controls and CV Inputs for All Effects Clock Resolution Control + CV Input Comes with Two Panels for Aesthetic Customization Specifications MPN Eurorack BitQuest Type Synth Module UPC 0000764283693051 Questions? You never know when youll need to duck under a laser cannon, or fight a giant eyeball, and you need to have portable and practical tools to face whatever alternate reality lays in store. Its the same thing with your tone–sometimes it pays to have a compact, digital multi-tool that covers a wide range of tone needs. Enter the BitQuest: Complete with eight digital effects that work with or without a built in digital fuzz, the BitQuest offers flanger, HP/LP filter, bit crusher, infinite reverb, notch filter, ring mod, pitch shift and glitch delay, all in one pedal.
